title: A week of every Tube and DLR train in London
description:
A week of every Tube and DLR train in London, Monday to Sunday, in 60 seconds. The feed has no London Overground, Elizabeth line or National Rail trains, so they are not shown.

Each day is the average of that weekday in October 2026, so Saturday is a typical Saturday, not one particular one. Vehicles outside Greater London are faded and not counted. Colours: Northern, Piccadilly, District, Central, Victoria and DLR, with everything else in grey.

Busiest moment: 497 Tube and DLR trains, Monday at 8:31 am.
The daily averages use every October 2026 date in each timetable. October 24 and October 25 are left out because the clocks change. Transport for London has fewer than three usable October Saturdays and Sundays, so its Saturday and Sunday each use one typical date.
